decision.message: The existing esp32_bmp280_v1 board family supports only a 120x80 mm two-layer board; it does not support a 60x40 mm four-layer board or an output relay for a motor as requested.

clauses.text: Create the pressure controller as a 60 by 40 mm four-layer board with an output relay for a motor.
